'''2008 New York State Championship Jeremy Knapp DS Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Jeremy Knapp]] at [[2008 New York State Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe|SE-D-huntdownanddestroythejedi.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' HDADTJ/TFHGOOTU
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS15]]
